components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal action button for marking progress.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg> MARK READ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; height:35px; padding:0 11px; border:1px solid #55b8b0; border-radius:5px; color:#0a0d0f; background:#55b8b0; font:600 10px/1 'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color:#0a0d0f; background:#73cbc2; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:15px; height:15px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Recessed map search with operational iconography.

components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:37px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #304341; border-radius:9px; color:#879b96; background:#0e1617; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:#d2a85e; outline:2px solid rgba(210,168,94,.3); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-search svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-search input { min-width:0; width:100%; border:0; outline:0; color:#e8edeb; background:none; font:11px 'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; }

components.name: Campaign Node
components.description: SVG book plate with pauldron-inspired notch and status state.
components.css: .ds-node { width:180px; min-height:74px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid #3a514d; border-radius:12px; color:#e8edeb; background:#152020; position:relative; } .ds-node-notch { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:30px; height:24px; border:1px solid #608b83; border-radius:12px 0 8px 0; background:#233a37; } .ds-node small,.ds-node em { display:block; color:#7b9790; font:7px/1.2 'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.07em; } .ds-node strong { display:block; margin:12px 0 8px; font:600 13px/1 'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Pathfinder treats the reading order as a tactical map: dark enough to feel like a work surface, structured enough to make a dense graph legible, and marked with small heraldic signals that give each route identity. The visual language is original rather than a reproduction of proprietary Warhammer artwork or insignia.

The interface uses tonal layering instead of decorative gloss. Teal carries action and route state; gold marks current position; faction colours are reserved for arc identity. The map itself is the primary material and the surrounding controls behave like a field console around it.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black canvas with gunmetal map plates.
Parchment-white type and restrained operational colour.
Pauldron-like node notches and compact mono labels.
Strong information hierarchy with minimal ornament.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Teal and gold are for state and action. Do not use them as generic decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use expressive sans-serif type for meaning and mono type for measurement, status, or classification.

dos: Do make the map, not a hero banner, the first thing the reader understands.
Do reserve teal for progress, action, and reachable route state.
Do use original geometric insignia and labelled faction data rather than copying proprietary marks.
Do provide a list-based alternative whenever the graph is difficult to navigate.
donts: Don't turn the map into a generic dashboard of equal cards.
Don't use gradients, neon glows, or colour as decoration without route meaning.
Don't make the small operational kicker labels into a universal page-eyebrow pattern; they are currently map-specific metadata.
Don't imply that the graph's curated relationships are an official or exhaustive reading order.
